names.note: Name page 14293 of days.pravoslavie.ru gives the surname the day line omits. The grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, as BRIEF-RUSSIAN §3 asks. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Алексия пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: The day's sixth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page behind it. THE TWO HALVES OF THE SOURCE GRADE HIM DIFFERENTLY — the line says «пресвитера», presbyter, and the name page «протоиерей», archpriest; `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are taken, those being the words the locale packs carry, and «протоиерей» is recorded and nowhere written. `new-martyr` as elsewhere on this day, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him — the corpus keeps `john-znamensky` and no Alexis of the name. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
